features.label: Sensil silicone construction
features.text: Proprietary material grips the calf to help reduce migration during activity.

features.label: Direct replacement liner
features.text: Specifically designed for compatibility with the Ossur Unloader One knee brace.

features.label: Hook and loop attachment
features.text: Liner secures to the brace frame for simple removal and quick replacement.

features.label: Comfort against the skin
features.text: Worn beneath the shell to cushion the calf throughout the day.

features.label: Two color options
features.text: Choose Black or Gray to match your current knee brace frame.

measurement: Calf liner size matches your Unloader One brace size, XS to XL; order the same size as your current brace frame. If unsure of your size, measure calf circumference 6 in. below mid-patella with the leg extended and match to the Unloader One brace size chart. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
